presets.title: Subagent roles
presets.help: Workspace-local worker presets, not chat assistants. Changes take effect only after Save; no roles are created automatically. Up to 16 roles.
presets.key_help: Unique lowercase ASCII key, 1–32 characters: letters, digits, _ or -. Start with a letter; default is reserved. The key cannot change after creation.
presets.name: Role name
presets.prompt_help: The fixed worker preamble is followed by this role prompt. A read-only instruction is a prompt, not a hard sandbox or permission boundary; roles share workspace tools and files.
presets.execution_notice: Role/model/parameter changes expire older queued calls; active tasks keep their startup configuration. Disabling or deleting roles, or reducing context access, can cancel all subagents in this workspace. Cancellation does not undo file changes.
presets.model_config_conflict: The model's custom request body overrides this role or its explicit generation settings. Adjust the model's advanced settings or the role parameters; this role cannot currently run.
presets.invalid_model_help: This fixed model is missing, disabled or not CHAT + TOOL. The role will not silently fall back. Select a valid model to repair it; unrelated edits retain the reference.
presets.workspace_model_invalid: The workspace default model is unavailable. Repair the model selection above, or use Parent / a valid fixed model for the role.
presets.context_help: Extra context is passed only when both this role and the workspace allow it; it is not the full parent conversation.
presets.context_blocked: The workspace currently blocks extra context. This role setting cannot override that restriction.
presets.catalogue_help: Informational preview of enabled role keys, names and descriptions. Full role prompts are not exposed in the parent catalogue or main tool result.
presets.copy_help: Creates a new role in the target. Existing roles are never overwritten; edit the key if it is already in use.
presets.target_corrupt: The target configuration is corrupt. Open that workspace and explicitly repair it before copying.
presets.delete_confirm: Delete role “{{name}}”? Its files will not be deleted.
presets.empty: No custom roles. The legacy default worker remains available; templates are opt-in.
presets.conflict: This role changed or was removed in another editor. Your draft is retained. Reload explicitly to discard it, or copy your edits before refreshing; saving uses the original version and will not overwrite newer changes.
presets.corrupt: Role configuration is corrupt and unavailable. It has not been replaced or cleared automatically.
presets.reset_confirm: Permanently clear the corrupt role configuration to an empty list? No template roles will be created.

errors.key_invalid: Use a valid non-reserved lowercase role key.
errors.key_duplicate: That role key is already in use. Choose another key.
errors.model_invalid: Choose an available CHAT + TOOL model.
errors.params_invalid: Generation parameters must be finite and within their displayed ranges; token limit must be a positive integer.
errors.steps_invalid: Maximum steps must be an integer between 1 and 120.

list.title: Workspaces
list.description: Open the on-device sandbox workspaces, browse and upload files, and attach an interactive terminal.
list.empty: No workspaces yet. Create one here, or create it first in the Android app.
list.harness_minimal_desc: Hide workspace read/write/edit/shell and expose only persistent bash and str_replace_editor.
list.delete_confirm: Delete workspace "{{name}}"? Files and the rootfs will be removed.

detail.subagent_desc: Dispatch a nested workspace worker for a bounded sandbox task. The worker cannot spawn further subagents.
detail.subagent_model_desc: Leave empty to use the parent chat model. Only models that support tools are listed.
detail.subagent_allow_context_desc: When enabled, the parent model can pass a context field to the worker. When disabled, the worker only sees the task prompt.
detail.compatibility_mode_desc: proot seccomp compatibility mode; required on some devices for the terminal to start. Applies to new terminal tabs and subsequent commands, and may be slower.
detail.first_message_snapshot: File list with the first message
detail.first_message_snapshot_desc: The first message of a conversation carries a listing of the working directory (like ls; depth set below), so the model does not need to run ls first. Taken when sent and not refreshed.
detail.mounts_desc: Turn a switch on to let the agent see that app-wide directory inside the shell. Toggling disconnects and restarts terminal and persistent bash sessions.

mount_desc.exposeUpload: Chat attachments uploaded in the app
mount_desc.exposeSkills: User /skills and packaged /builtin_skills files (packaged skills are view-only in App management)

detail.tool_approval_desc: When enabled, your confirmation is required before the AI calls this tool.
detail.tool_enablement_desc: When off, the tool is removed from the AI tool list and calls are rejected. This does not change its approval setting.
detail.tool_enablement_corrupt: The tool enablement config is corrupted. All workspace tools are restricted until you reset it.
detail.tool_enablement_reset_confirm: Reset tool enablement to defaults? Every workspace tool will be enabled again.
detail.first_message_snapshot_depth_desc: 1 lists only the working directory; more levels list subfolders indented. At most 200 entries in total; .git and node_modules are not expanded.

files.folder_import_cancelled: Import stopped. Files already copied remain in the original directory.
files.folder_import_partial: Copied {{uploaded}} files; {{failed}} files failed or were skipped.
files.linux_readonly: Linux files are preview-only and cannot be saved.
files.extension_help: Enter an extension without a leading dot (for example md or tar.gz). Leave it empty to create an empty folder, not an extensionless file.
files.filename_whitespace: Remove leading or trailing whitespace from the name. The name will not be trimmed automatically.
files.filename_control: The name cannot contain control characters (including DEL).
files.filename_unicode: The name contains an invalid Unicode character. Re-enter the name.
files.filename_too_long: The complete name, including the dot and extension, must be at most 255 UTF-8 bytes.
files.extension_whitespace: Remove leading or trailing whitespace from the extension. It will not be trimmed automatically.
files.extension_control: The extension cannot contain control characters (including DEL).
files.extension_unicode: The extension contains an invalid Unicode character. Re-enter the extension.
files.extension_dot: The extension cannot begin or end with a dot. Multiple parts such as tar.gz are allowed.
files.file_already_exists: A file or folder with this name already exists. Nothing was overwritten.
files.file_invalid_path: The target path is invalid. Refresh and choose an existing folder.
files.file_invalid_name: The name is invalid. Check the name and extension.
files.file_parent_missing: The parent folder no longer exists. Refresh before creating.
files.file_permission_denied: Permission to create in this folder was denied. Check access and device-directory activation.
files.file_too_large: The creation request exceeds the allowed size.
files.file_io_error: The file or folder could not be created because of a storage error.
files.file_symlink_not_allowed: Creation through a symbolic link is not allowed. Choose a regular folder.
files.file_created_open_failed: File created, but opening the editor failed. The file was kept; refresh and open it without creating it again.
files.file_created_not_opened: File created. The view changed, so the editor was not opened. The file was kept in the original folder.
files.file_created_refresh_failed: File created and opened, but refreshing the list failed. Refresh the list; do not create it again.
files.folder_created_refresh_failed: Folder created, but refreshing the list failed. Refresh the list; do not create it again.
files.create_result_present: The creation response was interrupted. After refreshing, the target name exists, but this request's result cannot be confirmed. Nothing was retried or overwritten; inspect the existing entry.
files.create_result_absent: The creation response was interrupted. After refreshing, the target name was not found. Nothing was retried; confirm the folder's contents before making another request.
files.create_result_unknown: The creation response was interrupted and refreshing also failed. The entry may already exist. Refresh to confirm the result before making another request.
files.move_desc: Choose a destination folder, in this workspace or another. Nothing there is overwritten: an item with the same name gets a number.
files.batch_delete_desc: The following {{count}} file(s)/folder(s) will be deleted (folders including all their contents). This cannot be undone.
files.transfer_conflicts: {{count}} item(s) share a name with something already there and will get a number, like “name (1)”.
files.transfer_renamed: ; {{count}} renamed because the name was taken

transfer_error.into_itself: a folder can't go into itself
transfer_error.symlink: symbolic links can't be moved or copied
transfer_error.name_taken: the name was just taken, try again

markdown_preview.title: Markdown view
markdown_preview.degraded: Large document: source-only editing above 128 Ki characters to bound parsing work (API read limit: {{limit}}). Preview remains available on request.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.not_ready: This workspace has no rootfs yet; install it to use the terminal.

chat_panel.title: Workspace files
chat_panel.unavailable_desc: The workspace may have been deleted, or the device is temporarily unreachable.
chat_panel.unsupported: Preview is not supported for this file type

device.direct_write_warning: Writes and deletes immediately change the original phone files. There is no staging or automatic rollback; these directories are not included in app backups.
device.title: Device directories
device.desc: Connect directories from shared phone storage directly into the workspace (writes in place, no copy). Mounts appear to agents under /device/<alias>.

status_hint.UNSUPPORTED_API: Device directories require Android 11 (API 30) or later; other workspace features are unaffected.
status_hint.PRIMARY_VOLUME_UNAVAILABLE: Primary shared storage is temporarily unavailable. Retry on the device.

device.permission_required_app: All-files access is not granted. Grant it in the Android app workspace settings — the web UI cannot request it.
device.unavailable: Device directory service is unavailable on this device.
device.add_desc: Pick a directory on shared storage and mount it under an alias.
device.alias_invalid: Alias must start with a lowercase letter and contain only a-z, 0-9, _ or - (max 32 chars)
device.remove_confirm: Unbind "{{alias}}"? Only the connection is removed — the directory on the phone is untouched.
device.files_inactive_hint: "{{alias}}" is not active. Enable and activate it to read/write files.

library.title: Global subagent presets
library.help: Shared worker definitions, separate from chat assistants. Up to 64 definitions and 16 roles per workspace. The four built-in roles are seeded once but never assigned automatically. Editing a global definition updates all its linked workspace copies.
library.assignment_help: Checked workspaces receive a linked copy on Save. Unchecking removes only that linked copy; independent local roles are preserved. Assignment does not override a disabled definition or workspace tool controls.
library.workspace_title: Global subagent presets in this workspace
library.workspace_help: Check to assign a shared role, uncheck to remove its linked copy. Edits belong in the global library. Workspace tool enablement, context limits and approvals still apply.
library.empty: No global presets. Create one explicitly.
library.definition_disabled: Globally disabled: assignment is retained, but this role cannot run. Enable the definition in the global editor.
library.local_help: These roles exist only in this workspace. They are not shared global presets; creating or cloning here makes an independent copy. Linked global copies appear above and can only be edited or deleted through the library.
library.targets_invalid: A selected workspace is unavailable, full, corrupt, or has a conflicting role key. Refresh or uncheck it before saving.
library.corrupt: The global preset library is corrupt. Existing data is not cleared automatically; reset it explicitly in the global library.
library.reset_confirm: Reset the corrupt global preset library? This is an explicit recovery action, not a way to clear a healthy library.
library.delete_confirm: Delete global preset “{{name}}” and remove all its linked workspace copies? Independent local roles are preserved.

blocks.loading: Workspace roles are not available yet. Refresh to retry.
blocks.corrupt: Workspace role configuration is corrupt. Repair it before assigning global presets.
blocks.key_conflict: An independent local role or another shared role already uses this key. It will never be overwritten. Rename/clone to a different key or remove the conflicting local role explicitly.
blocks.full: This workspace already has 16 roles. Remove one before assigning another.

editor_state.conflict: Conflict: the file was changed or deleted elsewhere. Your draft is retained. Discard and reopen to read the latest version; no automatic overwrite or retry.
editor_state.unknown: Save result unknown. Your draft is retained and automatic saving has stopped. Check the file separately; discard and reopen before editing again.
editor_state.error: Save rejected. Your draft is retained; automatic saving has stopped.
editor_state.missingRevision: Read-only: the server did not return a valid file revision. Update the server and reopen; unsafe legacy saving is disabled.
editor_state.leave_desc: Save, discard your draft, or cancel to continue editing. Failed or unconfirmed saves do not close the editor.
editor_state.not_utf8: This file is not valid UTF-8 and cannot be edited as text.
editor_state.not_text: This file contains non-text data and cannot be edited as text.
editor_state.atomic_unsupported: This device volume cannot safely replace the file atomically. The original file and your draft are retained.
editor_state.too_large: The file exceeds the text editing limit.
editor_state.permission_denied: File access was denied. Check permission and reopen.

extract.title: Extract “{{name}}”
extract.desc: Extracts next to the archive: a single top-level item is placed as is, several go into a new folder named after the archive. Existing files are never overwritten. Supports zip, 7z, rar, tar, gz, bz2 and xz, including encrypted archives.
extract.password_placeholder: Leave empty if there is none
extract.running: Extracting; large archives take a while…
extract.done_skipped: Extracted to {{name}} ({{count}} unsafe or unusable entries skipped)
extract.password_required: This archive is password protected. Enter the password.
extract.unsupported: Unsupported archive format (zip, 7z, rar, tar, gz, bz2 and xz are supported).
extract.corrupt: The archive is damaged or incomplete.
extract.encoding_unsupported: The selected file name encoding is not supported.
extract.not_found: The archive no longer exists; it may have been moved or deleted.

rootfs.install_desc: Downloads a Linux root filesystem (tar.gz) and extracts it into the Linux directory of “{{name}}”; the terminal and shell tools work once it is installed. It runs in the background, so leaving the page does not stop it.
rootfs.reinstall_desc: Downloads again and replaces the Linux directory of “{{name}}” (the /workspace files are not touched). Terminals of this workspace are closed during the install.
rootfs.url_hint: The default is the Ubuntu Base image for this device’s architecture; leave empty to use it.

tuiqiao.title: Refine
tuiqiao.hint: Refine the selection: get a few rewrites, click to copy, long-press to replace
tuiqiao.description: Rewrite options for the selected text
tuiqiao.settings_hint: Saved for every refine. Regular options use the current assistant's chat model; roles, file types and prompts are in All refine settings.
tuiqiao.changed: The original text has changed; nothing was replaced.

errors.SELECTION_TOO_LONG: The selection is too long (max 3000 characters)
errors.NO_MODEL: The current assistant has no usable chat model
errors.NO_CANDIDATES: The model returned no usable options
errors.MARKUP_BROKEN: Every option broke the formatting. Retry, or edit the source by hand

tuiqiao.pick_hint: Click to copy · long-press to replace the original (keyboard: Enter copies, Shift+Enter replaces). Closing the panel keeps these; refining the same text again shows them first — Regenerate asks for new ones.

zaizao.title: Recast
zaizao.hint: Recast the selection: write what to change, then edit, expand or rewrite it, round after round
zaizao.description: Rewrite the selected text as you ask
zaizao.pick_hint: Tap to copy · long-press to replace the original (keyboard: Enter copies, Shift+Enter replaces). Closing the panel keeps the conversation: select the same text and choose Recast to continue.

type_hints.MODIFY: Keep the draft and change parts of it as asked
type_hints.INCREMENT: Keep the draft and add new content as asked
type_hints.REWRITE: Extract the events and facts, then write it anew in a different way without reusing earlier techniques

zaizao.requirement: What to change, e.g. make it eerier

errors.NO_MODEL: No model available: choose one in the Recast settings or give the current assistant a chat model
errors.TOO_MANY_ROUNDS: Already 20 rounds; replace the text and start a new recast

typography.preview:
天地玄黄，宇宙洪荒。日月盈昃，辰宿列张。
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
typography.web_only: Web editor only; the App has its own under “Aa” in the editor.
typography.local_hint: uses “{{family}}” directly if this computer has it

focus.pick_file: Pick a file to edit on the right

split.title: Side by side
split.already_open: This file is already open in the other pane

writing.auto_pair_hint: Typing an opening symbol such as ( “ 《 adds its closer and marks the gap with a fill box; Enter inside the box jumps past the closer.
